inclusion_rule: Studies that classify or decode imagined, covert or inner speech from EEG or MEG and state whether each test decision uses one trial or an average over repeated trials of the same item. Boundary: averaging over subjects, folds or seeds is not test-trial averaging; ERP figures averaged for display only are excluded; perceived or overt speech alone is excluded; versions of one study count once.
